decisions.symbolsMode: searchSymbols runs SQL over brain_symbol JOIN brain_file — the indexed corpus, never a raw filesystem or git scan
decisions.contentMode: searchContent runs bounded SQL/FTS phases over the indexed symbol corpus (name, qualified name, docstring and the stored bounded body); the source header documents that this is NOT full-text file contents
decisions.symbolMode: findSymbol reads indexed AST records from the brain database and noise-classifies by RELATIVE path
decisions.fileMode: requires a brain_file row; refuses 'file is not indexed' when the row is absent — disk content is only read for indexed paths
decisions.freshness: every search engine calls checkResultsFreshness, which compares the stored SHA-256 file_hash against on-disk bytes; changed files are flagged stale, never fresh
decisions.bodyCoverage: bodyCoverage.withBody counts symbols whose stored body is non-empty; it is the disclosure that separates 'nothing matched' from 'nothing could match'
decisions.readBoundary: a content read must not create schema in the index database (proven on a fresh fixture by listing sqlite_master before/after)

limitations: The audit proves the index-backed claim statically (query shape) and dynamically (row-deletion probe); it does not re-verify analyzer symbol extraction.
Body reachability is proven on a TypeScript fixture whose analyzer stores symbol bodies; an analyzer that does not store bodies is represented by bodyCoverage, not repaired here.
